verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own support site lists how-to articles for learning the desktop, such as keyboard shortcuts and desktop themes, plus a guide to the PC Health Check app. Nothing in the evidence shows guided tutorials for installing the OS itself, so only part of the story is supported, and thinly. Missing for 10: documented step-by-step OS installation guides, structured guided onboarding tutorials for the desktop interface, switcher-oriented learning paths, and independent corroboration that the tutorials are effective.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can follow guided tutorials to install the OS and learn the desktop interface
